_what: Settings of the distance-based aggregator assignment (case study, meeting 22 Oct 2026). Read by scripts/paper1/case_study/make_aggregators.py; change a value only together with Nacho, then regenerate and commit the outputs.
distance: sum of |Rs + jXs| (series self-impedance of the phase conductor) of the cables on the radial path from the LV side of the prosumer's transformer to its bus; per unit on the model base (1 MVA, 0.4 kV: 1 p.u. = 0.16 ohm)
rank: within-transformer percentile of the distance (ties share the mean rank), so every transformer contributes near and far prosumers
group_sizes: per transformer: round(n/3) to the far aggregator, the rest split as evenly as possible between the two near aggregators (alternating the odd one by transformer)
weight: Gaussian of the percentile p: w = exp(-0.5*((p - mu)/sigma)^2); the far aggregator is drawn without replacement with probabilities proportional to w; the near ones by a seeded shuffle of the rest
